categories.summary: The discussion centered on USDC becoming the default payout asset in Eliza (PR #10732) instead of $elizaos tokens. zadayos raised concerns that this change eliminates $elizaos buybacks and reduces token utility. odilitime clarified that USDC is the default payout (not payment) for the new cloud business, while $elizaos remains an accepted payment token. The rationale is that businesses receiving payouts in $elizaos would likely dump the token, making USDC a safer option that actually benefits the token long-term. j_choy initially confused payment vs payout but received clarification. gblin_digital announced plugin-gblin 0.2.4, introducing GET_GBLIN_RISK_ATTESTATION action that allows Eliza agents to obtain cryptographic proof of market risk checks before trading. The agent pays $0.003 in USDC on Base (gasless) for a 10-minute EIP-712-signed proof of BTC/ETH risk regime. The plugin also includes treasury health checks, idle USDC parking into on-chain indexes, and JIT-swap functionality for invoice payments. All 4 actions and 1 provider work against live Base mainnet. mdmnvest shared a Twitter Spaces link about Ruby Trivia discussing vibe-coded games on an AMA.
